shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at −1 on the number line in the left image with the circular marker at 3 beside the gray region in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The marked interval excludes its left endpoint −1. Right image: The highlighted intersection includes its left endpoint 3.
Rationales: The selected left cue excludes the indicated boundary point. The selected right cue includes the indicated boundary point, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
